fields.Name: Predictive Studio Gates — Agent
fields.Description: The Model Development Agent's PR 5 gates: G4.1 (C1 -> C1.1: the agent builds only on a person's structured approval of the plan it presented) and G4.2 (C1 -> C1.2: a C1 planning session reads 0 holdout labels and writes no unit, protocol or training run before approval). Later PR 5 milestones add G4.3–G4.9 here. G4.1 and G4.2 run on the server transport (the agent runs as the D5-46 person), and a server-transport bundle cannot follow a client-transport one in one process (#3251), so the truth datasets are loaded before this suite: run "Predictive Studio Gates — Containment" (its first test loads them) or `pnpm mj test run "PS truth datasets: load and verify"` first. Needs the truth sidecar, `pnpm run truth:provision` and `truth:loom` done, the LLM keys and the D5-46 user; spends LLM money. Run with: MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — Agent"
